label: For "Corporate Relationship Manager Lead Prioritisation": Rank corporate clients and prospects for relationship-manager outreach by the likelihood and value of a product need. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past calls were not random, so outcomes reflect who was called and not who needed a product.
